primitives.name: Scalarized Signal Aggregator
primitives.verbatim_quote: You find code that already exists, you measure it on previous seasons, you wire a measured number, you weight it only through the scalarizer below, and you calibrate it only on a holdout you did not fit.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'g': 'dimensionless scalar weight', 'f2': 'measured signal value in (0, 1)', 'w': 'weight coefficient'}
primitives.assumptions: Signals are independently measurable, weights are fixed, and holdout data is representative.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When f2 = 0 or w = 0, the contribution vanishes; when g = 0.5, the system is neutral.

layer2.mapping: Maps empirical signal values to a calibrated scalar output via fixed-weighted sum.
layer2.telemetry: Mean squared error on holdout set.

primitives.name: Truth Consistency Verifier
primitives.verbatim_quote: When that document and this prompt disagree, this prompt wins.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'prompt': 'boolean flag indicating prompt precedence', 'document': 'boolean flag indicating document precedence'}
primitives.assumptions: Prompt has higher authority than external documents.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When prompt and document conflict, prompt overrides.

layer2.mapping: Enforces operational hierarchy between internal prompt and external intel.

primitives.name: Signal Measurement Engine
primitives.verbatim_quote: When this prompt and a measurement disagree, the measurement wins and you write both numbers down.
primitives.assumptions: Measurement is more accurate than prompt-derived estimates.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Disagreement triggers dual recording and validation.

layer2.mapping: Records and reconciles discrepancies between prompt and empirical signal.
layer2.telemetry: Number of disagreements per signal type.
